name: 橙黄破晓
direction: Sunrise orange #F05A24 and golden yellow #FFBB22, warm energetic identity. A bold rising semicircle with three broad rays integrated into a distinctive D-shaped silhouette; smart negative space. Charcoal wordmark.

name: 珊瑚跃动
direction: Coral red #F44357 with peach #FFC1A5. A single fluid ribbon folds upward into a lively abstract lowercase d with a tiny deliberate gap. Broad friendly rounded form; confident coral wordmark. No sun or circle emblem.

name: 紫粉灵感
direction: Electric violet #713DE8 and hot pink #F14FBA. Two intersecting bold petal-like planes form a compact asymmetric spark with a central negative-space T. Sophisticated creative-tools identity, geometric rather than flower illustration. Violet wordmark.

name: 蓝色捷径
direction: Vivid cobalt blue #2458F5 and cyan #52C9FA. Bespoke interlocking T and D monogram built from two strong geometric strokes, one diagonal cut suggests speed and a shortcut. Clean technical confidence, cobalt wordmark. Never dark teal.

name: 青柠新芽
direction: Fresh grass green #4D982F and vivid lime #BDEB3A. Two chunky sprout shapes unite with an open D bowl, optimistic fresh growth. Simple asymmetric silhouette, forest-green wordmark. NO teal, NO turquoise.

name: 玫红窗口
direction: Strong raspberry magenta #CA176E and blush pink #FFB3D0. An abstract open window made from three solid rounded rectangular pieces framing a small upward diagonal opening, discover useful possibilities. Magenta wordmark, editorial contemporary feel. No arrows copied from existing logos.

name: 金色工坊
direction: Sunflower yellow #FFC928 and warm near-black #32291D. Three chunky interlocking blocks construct a compact T monogram, like a clever modular tool assembly. Bold cheerful maker identity, flat yellow and black. Wide sturdy wordmark with carefully spaced letters. No sun symbol.

name: 四色协作
direction: A deliberately multicolour mark: orange #FF7A35, violet #8355E9, pink #EF559D, sky blue #43B3EA, each in one clearly defined large piece. Four offset rounded modules form a distinctive open ring with a D-shaped negative space. Balanced playful professional identity, charcoal wordmark. No gradients, no Google or Microsoft resemblance.

name: 赤红飞鸟
direction: Vermilion red #E5462D with apricot #FFB56C. A compact abstract bird lifting into flight made from two broad angular wings and negative space; optimism at dawn, no detailed feathers or eyes. Dynamic but simple, red wordmark with slightly forward custom letterforms. Avoid resembling airline logos.

name: 暖紫地平线
direction: Plum purple #733D89 with tangerine orange #FA8B39. A bespoke D glyph with a clean horizontal sunrise cut and an orange half-disc emerging from the cut, substantial simple geometry. More architectural and composed than playful. Plum wordmark with distinctive balanced T and D.
